Johnson was shut out through three quarters and finished 0 catches on 2 targets, against the model's 5.6 (Yahoo, ESPN/Athlon recaps, NBC Rotoworld). I found no injury or role change behind it.

The model knew all three were out, but it still tagged him 'WR4+' and cut his projection with roleFactor 0.667, even though he played 91.7% of snaps the week before.
